title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Certificate Limit Schedule by Tier
content:
Under the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs**, each tier places one kind of building and fixes how the building limit of a certificate is set, the limits a certificate may carry and the increment to which a computed limit is rounded up.

## Terms of the schedule
- **Building placed:** kind of building the tier places.
- **Limit method:** how the certificate building limit is set.
- **NFIP maximum building reference:** NFIP maximum building limit for the occupancy, used in the mandatory purchase amount.
- **Highest building limit:** highest building limit one certificate carries.
- **Lowest building limit:** lowest building limit Tidemark issues on a certificate.
- **Contents placed:** whether contents coverage is placed where the lender's security interest covers contents.
- **Highest contents limit:** highest contents limit on one certificate (0 where unavailable).
- **Rounding increment:** increment to which a computed certificate limit is rounded up.

## Schedule

| Tier | Building placed | Limit method | NFIP maximum building reference | Highest building limit | Lowest building limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount | Residential | Mandatory purchase amount | 250000 dollars | 250000 dollars | 5000 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Gap | Residential | Gap to the mandatory purchase amount | 250000 dollars | 250000 dollars | 1000 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Replacement Cost | Residential | Replacement cost | 250000 dollars | 1000000 dollars | 5000 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Manufactured Home | Manufactured | Mandatory purchase amount | 250000 dollars | 250000 dollars | 5000 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building | Commercial | Mandatory purchase amount | 500000 dollars | 500000 dollars | 5000 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building and Contents | Commercial | Mandatory purchase amount | 500000 dollars | 500000 dollars | 5000 dollars |

| Tier | Contents placed | Highest contents limit |
|---|---|---|
| Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount | No | 0 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Gap | No | 0 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Replacement Cost | No | 0 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Manufactured Home | No | 0 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building | No | 0 dollars |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building and Contents | Yes | 500000 dollars |

Rounding increment on every tier: **100 dollars**.

## Points of judgement
- *Which tier allows a building limit above the NFIP maximum building reference?* Only Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Replacement Cost, whose highest building limit is 1000000 dollars against a reference of 250000 dollars.
- *Which tier issues the smallest certificates?* Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Gap, whose lowest building limit is 1000 dollars; every other tier's lowest is 5000 dollars.
- *Which tier carries contents?* Only Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building and Contents, up to 500000 dollars.
